def settings(keys: list[str], values: list[str]) -> list[str]:
    """Overlay keys[i] = values[i] on the defaults mode=fast and level=3.

    Returns the value of mode, then the value of level, then the values of any
    other keys in the order they first appear. If a key repeats, the later
    value wins.
    """
    pre keys.len() == values.len()
    post out.len() >= 2
    ex settings(keys=[], values=[]) == ["fast", "3"]
    ex settings(keys=["mode"], values=["slow"]) == ["slow", "3"]
    ex settings(keys=["x", "level", "y"], values=["a", "5", "b"]) == ["fast", "5", "a", "b"]
    ex settings(keys=["x", "x"], values=["a", "b"]) == ["fast", "3", "b"]
    mode = "fast"
    level = "3"
    others: dict[str, str] = {}
    order: list[str] = []
    for i in range(keys.len()):
        k = keys[i]
        v = values[i]
        if k == "mode":
            mode = v.copy()
        elif k == "level":
            level = v.copy()
        else:
            if k in others:
                others[k.copy()] = v.copy()
            else:
                order.append(k.copy())
                others[k.copy()] = v.copy()
    out: list[str] = [mode, level]
    for k in order:
        out.append(others.get(k) else "")
    return out
